letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, every sunrise in Dubai and every monsoon breeze in Ahmedabad reminds me how lucky I am to call you my cutie. From the glittering skyline to the fragrant lilacs of spring, my heart beats only for you. I still remember the sparkle in your eyes on that magical 23rd of February, and each day since has been a beautiful chapter we write together. Thank you for filling my world with love, laughter, and endless wonder.
poem:
In desert dunes or mango trees,  
Your smile dances on my heart's seas.  
Across the miles, our love’s a song,  
Together, forever—where we belong.
